messages:
Alice Wang: CI regression on audit-event-validator after the RBAC schema update — golden fixtures mismatch and export shape changed
sec-bot: [ci] audit-fixtures-check failed on commit 3a9f7d
Ben Ortiz: can you paste failing event + job link?
Alice Wang: https://ci.redwood/integrations/3a9f7d
Alice Wang: failing assertion: expected actor.id to be string but got object
Alice Wang: sample payload:
```
{
  "event_type": "model.deploy",
  "actor": { "type": "service", "id": { "team": "ml", "svc": "deploybot" } },
  "resource": "model:abc",
  "ts": "2026-02-15T12:14:31Z"
}
```
Carla M.: that matches last week's RBAC change (principal -> nested id). Customers consuming audit exports expect flat actor.id string.
David R: we can't silently break exports. Need compatibility plan: either transform on export or bump schema + customer communication
Ben Ortiz: my validator change made the check strict to catch ambiguous IDs. It caught it correctly. But for public exports we need lenient/compat mode
Carla M.: suggested plan: add exporter transform to serialize nested id as string for backward compat, then re-enable strict validator behind feature flag for internal telemetry
Alice Wang: I'll open a revert PR for strictness to unblock main, plus a follow-up PR with transform + migration tests (e2e/audit_migrations)
Ben Ortiz: I'll own console parsing fix if we change shape. Also will add a consumer-compat test in frontend CI
Carla M.: also regenerate golden fixtures only after we agree on exported shape. Add a README in eng-security/test-fixtures about updating golden files
sec-bot: failing tests: audit-fixtures-check, audit-schema-regression
David R: file a compatibility ticket and label P2. Avoid breaking patch releases; target the change for next minor with migration window
Alice Wang: PRs: #1490 revert strictness, #1491 exporter-transform + tests. Will run canary after merge
Carla M.: pinging @oncall @legal for compliance sign-off if we alter public audit exports
Ben Ortiz: thanks all. once migrations and canaries pass, we can plan a customer notice if needed :+1:
